subject: Kickoff: Fisher-BRC offline RL baseline track
body:
Team — kicking off the Fisher-BRC adoption track for agents-rl.

The method regularizes the critic with a Fisher divergence penalty, which in the paper's benchmarks stabilizes offline RL where naive Q-learning collapses — and offline is the setting our product teams actually live in: they have logged interaction data and no appetite for live exploration.

Plan: (1) repro the paper's results on the D4RL locomotion suite — hopper-medium-expert-v0 and friends — by Apr 24, including the Mujoco licensing setup; (2) port the training loop onto our internal logged-interaction datasets in May; (3) a recommendation memo by Jun 12 on whether Fisher-BRC becomes the default offline baseline in our RL toolkit, feeding the Q3 OKR discussion.

Gustavo owns repro, Freya the internal-data port, Bilal infra, Linnea evaluation. Ivo follows up on staffing.

Ulla
